topics.topic_name: Vector spaces, subspaces, basis, dimension, span

resources.title: Essence of Linear Algebra (full series)
resources.why_recommended: The single best geometric-intuition builder for span, basis, and linear combinations; chapters 2-3 directly develop the ideas of spanning sets and basis vectors visually.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Linear Algebra (Spring 2010) - full course
resources.why_recommended: Strang's canonical treatment of the four fundamental subspaces, spanning, basis and dimension is the gold standard for exam-level rigor with clear intuition.

resources.title: NPTEL Linear Algebra (IIT Madras)
resources.why_recommended: An IIT Madras NPTEL course covering vector spaces, subspaces, basis and dimension in the exact style and depth expected for GATE.

resources.title: Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th Edition (official book page)
resources.why_recommended: The definitive companion textbook; its early chapters build vector spaces, subspaces, basis and dimension with problem sets and solution links.

resources.title: Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors | Essence of linear algebra, chapter 2
resources.why_recommended: The clearest visual explanation of when vectors are linearly (in)dependent and why redundant vectors do not add to the span.

resources.title: Vectors and spaces: Linear dependence and independence (Khan Academy)
resources.why_recommended: A step-by-step, worked-example approach to testing linear independence and finding a basis, with free practice exercises.

resources.title: Interactive Linear Algebra (Georgia Tech) - Linear Independence chapter
resources.why_recommended: Free interactive textbook with manipulable figures that make the definition and tests for linear independence concrete.

topics.topic_name: Matrices and special matrix types (projection, orthogonal, idempotent, partition matrices)

resources.title: MIT 18.06SC Linear Algebra (Fall 2011) - with recitations
resources.why_recommended: Contains dedicated lectures on projection matrices and orthogonal matrices plus recitation problem-solving videos, covering the idempotent projection property P^2 = P.

resources.title: Linear transformations and matrices | Essence of linear algebra, chapter 3
resources.why_recommended: Builds the geometric meaning of matrices as transformations, the foundation needed to understand projection and orthogonal matrices intuitively.

resources.title: NPTEL Linear Algebra (IIT Madras)
resources.why_recommended: Covers special matrix classes (orthogonal, idempotent, projections) with the theorem-and-proof rigor useful for GATE conceptual questions.

resources.title: The determinant | Essence of linear algebra, chapter 6
resources.why_recommended: Explains the determinant as the scaling factor of area/volume under a transformation - the intuition that makes every determinant property obvious.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 18: Properties of Determinants
resources.why_recommended: Strang derives all determinant properties from three axioms - exactly the property-based reasoning GATE tests.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 19: Determinant Formulas and Cofactors
resources.why_recommended: Covers the big formula and cofactor expansion for computing determinants, directly relevant to GATE numerical problems.

topics.topic_name: Systems of linear equations and Gaussian elimination

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 2: Elimination with Matrices
resources.why_recommended: The definitive lecture on Gaussian elimination, pivots, and back-substitution expressed as matrix operations.

resources.title: The Geometry of Linear Equations | MIT 18.06 Lecture 1
resources.why_recommended: Frames systems of equations through both the row and column picture, essential geometric intuition for solvability.

resources.title: Vectors and spaces - Matrices for solving systems by elimination (Khan Academy)
resources.why_recommended: Worked examples of row reduction and reduced row echelon form with free practice sets to drill the mechanics.

topics.topic_name: Rank and nullity (rank-nullity theorem, solvability of systems)

resources.title: Inverse matrices, column space and null space | Essence of linear algebra, chapter 7
resources.why_recommended: Gives the geometric meaning of rank (output dimension), column space and null space, making the rank-nullity relationship intuitive.

resources.title: MIT 18.06SC Linear Algebra - Ax = b and the Four Subspaces
resources.why_recommended: Strang's four-subspaces framework is the cleanest route to the rank-nullity theorem and complete conditions for solvability of Ax=b.

resources.title: Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th Edition (official book page)
resources.why_recommended: Its complete-solution chapter ties rank, free variables and the rank-nullity theorem to the number of solutions of a system.

topics.topic_name: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors (incl. diagonalization, characteristic polynomial, algebraic vs geometric multiplicity)

resources.title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues | Essence of linear algebra, chapter 14
resources.why_recommended: The most intuitive introduction to eigenvectors, eigenvalues and eigenbasis/diagonalization, showing why the axes of a transformation matter.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 21: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
resources.why_recommended: Strang derives eigenvalues via det(A - lambda I) = 0 and works the characteristic polynomial, the core computational skill for GATE.

resources.title: NPTEL Linear Algebra (IIT Madras)
resources.why_recommended: Treats diagonalizability, algebraic vs geometric multiplicity and defective matrices rigorously - the exact distinctions GATE probes.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 25: Symmetric Matrices and Positive Definiteness
resources.why_recommended: Connects symmetric matrices, real eigenvalues and positive definiteness, laying the exact groundwork for quadratic forms.

resources.title: MIT 18.065 Lecture 5: Positive Definite and Semidefinite Matrices
resources.why_recommended: Presents all equivalent tests for positive definiteness (eigenvalues, pivots, leading minors, energy x^T S x > 0), the full toolkit for quadratic-form questions.

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 4: Factorization into A = LU
resources.why_recommended: The canonical derivation of A = LU from Gaussian elimination, showing exactly how the multipliers fill in the lower-triangular L.

resources.title: Factorization into A = LU | MIT 18.06SC page (notes + problems)
resources.why_recommended: Companion page with summary notes, worked problem sets and solutions for LU (and PA = LU with permutations).

resources.title: MIT 18.06 Lecture 29: Singular Value Decomposition
resources.why_recommended: Strang's classic derivation of A = U Sigma V^T from A^T A and A A^T - the clearest first exposure to SVD.

resources.title: MIT 18.065 Lecture 6: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
resources.why_recommended: A more modern, data-focused treatment of SVD with rank-one pieces and applications - excellent for the data-science angle.

resources.title: Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th Edition (official book page)
resources.why_recommended: The SVD chapter links section notes, problem sets and solutions, reinforcing the video lectures for written practice.
